summary.description: One-paragraph human-readable summary of what was pushed and what resampling showed afterward.

post_state.description: JSON object of the RAW tool output you actually received from pyats_device_health / pyats_get_neighbors calls on R1, R2, SW1, SW2 AFTER pushing -- not your own paraphrase. Keyed by device name.

results.description: JSON object keyed by exactly R1, R2, SW1, SW2. Each value is an object with "success" (boolean), "config_commands" (what was actually pushed), "diff" (the unified diff pyats_configure_with_diff returned), and "rollback_performed" (boolean, true if pyats_rollback_config was called for this device).
